name: Market-First Research

runtime_review.compute/market_attention.py: Full observed universe, adjusted completed-session return groups, fixed prior peers, common comparison coverage and session endpoints. Missing histories and unverified adjustment stay explicit. No exact index contribution without dated weights.
runtime_review.services/aql/pipeline.py: Existing numerical production precedes common research selection and remains broad for ranking and macro consumers, including N=0. One shared agenda replaces independent Home investigations; existing graph, claims, economic datasets and serializers preserved.
runtime_review.services/aql/events.py: One upfront Zopedia agenda, focused selected questions with access to wider originals, exact prior artifact selection and original research/source dates. Parallel workers retain shared allowance, original deadline and existing review. Current acquisition/review failures stay partial without discarding valid findings. Common planning uses headline metadata and prior-coverage metadata; selected investigations retain full relevant prior findings, reviews and limitations. All full originals remain readable.
runtime_review.pipeline/jobs/attention_home_build.py: Existing Home producer owns complete history, prior textual findings, stable source captures, same-research ticker projections and one canonical public story contract. Shared Zopedia writes Attention then its Brief; technical identities belong to the application. Existing charts, drilldowns, narration and optional page producers retained. Public writing receives findings once; complete reviewed claims and originals remain in the existing reader. A concise task request replaces accumulated instructions.
runtime_review.services/attention_home_1d.py: Optional selected_symbols bypasses old name shortlist only when caller explicitly supplies it; default behavior remains unchanged for other callers.
runtime_review.services/attention_materialized.py: Additive numerical context roundtrip and strict as-of history cutoff. Existing stored publication fields preserved; no database migration.
runtime_review.services/home_view.py: API projects all selected published stories; removes hidden 16-story cutoff. Both client renderers already map the complete supplied list.
runtime_review.services/pipeline_store.py: Task-specific research pointer filtering occurs before loading large unrelated artifacts. Real PostgreSQL listing checks cover task, subject and omitted task; financial ownership and publication contracts unchanged.
runtime_review.services/zopedia_agent.py: Corrected the existing reviewer objective at source: artifact purpose controls selection and preservation. Removed unconditional high-recall competing-answer instructions; preserve source population, metric and comparison. Research retains useful hypotheses, complete knowledge rewrites preserve original detail. No new stage, gate, retry loop or response schema. Final synthesis now uses the existing shared writing prompt for both JSON and Markdown; only output serialization differs. This removes the separate research-report writer instruction without adding a model call. One provider-compatible decision field carries the complete artifact or evidence navigation, removing the redundant answer wrapper. Actual recorded complete review accepted with one offline gateway invocation and no new provider request. Review preserves the distinction between source observations, author interpretation and inference against the stated comparison baseline.

publication_precision_issue.source_review: Read the complete3746character article. It compares net interest with the prior year and says the numerical match suggests an explanation; it provides no analyst interest-cost assumption.
publication_precision_issue.candidate_issue: The public story and Brief say the EPS miss is explained by interest. A prior-year expense comparison does not by itself establish the variance against consensus. The issue is excessive certainty, not incorrect reported earnings figures.
